rationale: The workflow is a release publishing pipeline (triggered on published releases) with two independent jobs that download artifacts and publish to Modrinth and CurseForge. It contains no matrix, no scheduled runs, no build/test steps, and no dependency installation that could be cached. The available evidence patterns (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE, P-LIT-FAIL-FAST, P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE, P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, etc.) target build/test workflows and require preconditions such as matrix configurations, representative historical run data, scheduled triggers, or dependency fetching — none of which are present. The single historical run in the repository context is a failure and insufficient for timeout tuning. No evidence-supported optimization applies to this workflow without violating its intended coverage or introducing unsupported changes.
